name: Illumination Acquisition Corp I
summary: Illumination Acquisition Corp. I is established as a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), often referred to as a blank check company. Its core objective is to achieve a strategic business combination—encompassing mergers, asset purchases, share exchanges, or corporate reorganizations—with one or more operating enterprises. The entity was founded on November 18, 2025, and operates from its headquarters in New York, NY.
